title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3, section 31 (Roderick Haig-Brown Recreation Area)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 3 No Shooting or Hunting Areas (Section 4)
Roderick Haig-Brown Recreation Area
31 That portion of M.U. 3-37, in the vicinity of Chase, contained within the following described boundaries: That portion of the Roderick Haig-Brown Recreation Area being south of the Squilax-Anglement Road and downstream of the Adams River bridge. [en. B.C. Reg. 162/87, s. 7.] Repealed 32-34 Repealed. [B.C. Reg. 204/91, s. 1.]
